title: Affine subspace proof tester
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $V$ be a linear subspace of the Boolean cube $\\mathbb{F}_2^n$, and let $a\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$. The tester on Boolean functions over the disjoint union of the $n$ input positions and $2^n$ proof positions is the truth-table lift of the tester associated with the affine coset $a+V$, and makes three queries.
caveat: The referenced affine-character tester and truth-table lift are not defined in the supplied snippet, so their precise behavior cannot be stated.
